event_detail: Drawer below the counter at the left corner: from 46.4 to 51.2 s the open, empty gripper hovers at the left edge of the drawer next to the tall corner cabinet, barely moving. It neither pulls the drawer nor picks anything.
evidence: The shoulder views show nearly the same arm pose in all 4 frames. The drawer front with the black handle looks flush (closed) both at the start and at the end. The wrist view shows the cabinet face, a dark gap, the floor and a small white bracket-like piece near the left finger, with the fingers open and nothing held. No straw is visible in the gripper and the cup is never approached. The arm hides part of the corner, so a slightly ajar drawer cannot be fully ruled out.
